title: Foundation UI Page-Family Runtime Parity
description: Minimal shared page-family foundation for expedition-planning and dungeon-runtime UI migrations. Defines route/screen/component boundaries, runtime/headless view-model adapter shape, NavigationShell entry/return/continue semantics, stable state-slot naming, interaction handoff conventions, and screenshot parity harness pattern without implementing individual reference pages.

in_scope: Abstract route/screen/component boundary definitions for expedition-planning page family
Abstract route/screen/component boundary definitions for dungeon-runtime page family
Shared NavigationShell flow semantics and transition validation
Frontend intent → runtime payload handoff conventions
Classification of runtime data blockers as game-gap/framework-gap/core-gap
Dependent implementation task inventory with dependency ordering
out_of_scope: Implementation of individual reference page screens
Framework crate modifications (unless blocker classified as core-gap/framework-gap)
Asset pipeline or original asset path mapping
Combat AI or encounter balance tuning
Save/load campaign persistence beyond contract boundary

flow_state_model.description: High-level flow states form a navigation shell used by both replay-driven and live-runtime modes.

frontend_intent_model.description: Frontend intents represent player actions that trigger flow state transitions.

runtime_payload_model.description: Runtime payloads represent engine events that trigger flow state transitions.

payload_classification.emitted_by: Boss defeat or exit room reached

entry_semantics.description: Every screen has a single canonical entry intent and a set of pre-conditions.
entry_semantics.pattern: Screen receives viewModel via snapshot; entry guard validates current flowState + viewModel.kind match; FlowController::canTransition enforces guard

return_semantics.description: Return navigation uses previous_state in NavigationShell; screens may also emit explicit return-to-town intent.
return_semantics.pattern: return-to-town intent transitions to Town regardless of current screen (with character-hit exception); NavigationShell::go_back() uses previous_state
return_semantics.return_guard: isCharacterHitAcknowledgement blocks return-to-town during combat hit phase

continue_semantics.description: Continue flows progress forward within a page family or to the next family.
patterns: expedition-planning → provisioning → dungeon-hint → expedition → dungeon-assist → dungeon-map
continue_semantics.continue_guard: Each continue intent has screen-specific validation in FlowController::canTransition

design_principles: View models are read-only data shapes — no behavior, only data
Product-owned — defined in game_ddgc_headless, not framework crates
Unsupported states produce explicit ViewModelError rather than silent partial data
Adapters map from framework payloads to DDGC-specific shapes

bridge_contract.description: Frontend bridge consumes contract types, not framework types directly.
bridge_contract.live_bridge: LiveRuntimeBridge — creates synthetic view models from hardcoded data
bridge_contract.replay_bridge: ReplayRuntimeBridge — creates synthetic view models from replay fixtures
bridge_contract.target_bridge: Future RealRuntimeBridge — maps DdgcHost + adapters to snapshots

state_slot_naming.description: Stable state-slot names for session persistence and screenshot parity correlation.
state_slot_naming.naming_convention: snake_case matching view_model.kind with underscores for multi-word concepts. State slots are persisted only when they represent campaign-significant decisions (party selection, room progress, encounter state). Transient slots (hint, setup, result, return) are not persisted independently.

interaction_handoff_conventions.description: Conventions for how frontend interactions are validated, dispatched, and acknowledged.

layers.responsibility: Renders view model; captures user input; calls callback props
Validates intent against current snapshot; returns TransitionValidation
layers.pattern: Every intent type has explicit screen guard, viewModel kind check, and state-specific validation

layers.responsibility: Dispatches validated intent to runtime; emits updated snapshot
layers.pattern: dispatchIntent(intent) → Promise<DdgcFrontendSnapshot>; subscribe(listener) for reactive updates

layers.responsibility: Maps runtime state to view model; validates against contract types
layers.pattern: Adapter takes framework/engine types → returns DDGC ViewModelResult<T>

handoff_rules: Screens never dispatch intents directly — they invoke callback props provided by the session container
FlowController validates BEFORE bridge dispatch; invalid intents are rejected with reason string
Bridge emits snapshots reactively; screens re-render on snapshot change
Adapter errors are surfaced as ViewModelError in the snapshot, not thrown exceptions
All intent types are enumerated in DdgcFrontendIntent union (frontend/src/bridge/contractTypes.ts:569)

screenshot_parity_harness.description: Pattern for verifying migrated screens match reference screenshots from original Unity UI.

parity_pattern.step_2_capture: Playwright test navigates to screen via replay bridge, captures full-page screenshot
parity_pattern.step_3_compare: pixelmatch or perceptual diff against reference (tolerance for font rendering)
parity_pattern.step_4_report: Diff output saved to test-results/ with percentage mismatch

required_new_harness_tests.acceptance_threshold: 95% structural match (labels, layout regions, button positions); color exactness not required
90% structural match (procedural map layout may vary)

key_interaction_verification.description: Beyond screenshots, verify critical interactions behave correctly.
key_interaction_verification.pattern: Playwright test exercises intent sequence and asserts snapshot transitions

sequence: enter-room (combat) → combat resolves → continue-from-combat → result → continue-from-result → return → resume-from-return

30_percent_review_evidence.description: Implementation tasks must produce review evidence covering at least 30% of their surface area.
evidence_types: Interaction trace log (intent sequence + snapshot transitions)
30_percent_review_evidence.minimum_coverage: For each page family, at least one screen must have full screenshot parity + interaction trace, and all adapters must have unit test coverage ≥ 30% of adapter branches.

runtime_data_blockers.description: Blockers identified that must be resolved before implementation tasks proceed.

blockers.description: Plane content definitions (QingLong, BaiHu, ZhuQue, XuanWu) are not loaded from contract data. ExpeditionPlanningViewModel.planes is hardcoded in both LiveRuntimeBridge and ReplayRuntimeBridge.
blockers.impact: Cannot implement real expedition-planning adapter without plane catalog data source.
blockers.resolution: Add plane definitions to data/Planes.json or extend Quests.json with plane metadata. Implement parse_planes_json in src/contracts/parse.rs. Load into PlaneRegistry in DdgcHost.

blockers.description: DungeonSelectViewModel does not have a corresponding Rust viewmodel type in src/contracts/viewmodels.rs. Only TS contract exists.
blockers.impact: Bridge contract leakage risk — TS defines shapes Rust does not validate.
blockers.resolution: Add DungeonSelectViewModel to src/contracts/viewmodels.rs with serde Serialize/Deserialize. Add to DdgcViewModel union in contractTypes.ts if needed.

blockers.description: DungeonHintViewModel, DungeonAssistViewModel, DungeonMapViewModel, DungeonInteractionViewModel do not have corresponding Rust viewmodel types.
blockers.impact: Same as B-012 — TS-only contracts without Rust validation.
blockers.resolution: Add all four view models to src/contracts/viewmodels.rs with serde. Ensure kind discriminator strings match TS exactly.

blockers.description: framework_progression Run/Floor/Room types are not yet mapped to DDGC dungeon map visualization. The framework provides room topology but DDGC needs map grid coordinates (x, y) for the DungeonMapViewModel.
blockers.impact: DungeonMapScreen cannot display procedural dungeons without coordinate mapping.
blockers.resolution: Investigate framework_progression RoomId/Exit mapping. If framework does not provide grid coordinates, implement game-layer grid layout generator in src/planner/ or src/run/. This is game-gap if framework topology is sufficient; framework-gap if framework lacks room position data entirely.
blockers.status: Open — needs investigation of framework_progression room API

blockers.description: Curio/Trap/Obstacle interaction outcomes are not modeled in contract types. DungeonInteractionViewModel shows choices but the runtime resolution of each choice is undefined.
blockers.impact: Cannot implement real dungeon interaction adapter without outcome resolution rules.
blockers.resolution: Define interaction outcome contracts in src/contracts/ (e.g., CurioOutcome, TrapOutcome). Implement resolution in src/run/ using curio_registry + trap_registry + obstacle_registry. Add to tests/curio_trap_obstacle_registry.rs.

blockers.description: Provisioning supply items (food, torch, bandage, etc.) are hardcoded in LiveRuntimeBridge. No SupplyRegistry exists in DdgcHost.
blockers.impact: ProvisioningViewModel.supplies is synthetic; cannot support dynamic supply rules.
blockers.resolution: Add Supplies.json or extend existing contract data with supply definitions. Implement SupplyRegistry in src/contracts/. Load in DdgcHost::load_contract_packages.

dependency_rules_compliance.ddgc_content_location: All DDGC-specific migration content (plane definitions, supply rules, interaction outcomes, view models, adapters) remains in DDGC_newArch repository.
dependency_rules_compliance.framework_type_leakage: Contract JSON schemas (view models, campaign state) use only primitive types, String, Vec, BTreeMap — no framework-specific types (ActorId, EncounterId, RunId, etc.) leak into contract JSON.
dependency_rules_compliance.framework_internal_dependency: No task depends on framework internals. B-014 requires investigation of framework_progression public API only.
dependency_rules_compliance.state_flow_location: NavigationShell, FlowState, FrontendIntent, RuntimePayload, and GameState remain in src/state/.
dependency_rules_compliance.contract_boundary_location: DdgcHost, view models, adapters, and contract JSON schemas remain in src/contracts/.

precondition_checks: frontend tests pass (npm test in frontend/)
